title: catcopter - an open multiplayer game where you can fly a quadcopter cat and fight with pterodactyls (also chickens!)
author: pawel-dot-io
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I wanted to share a game that I made recently - it was in my head for years but never had enough time to get to it. Main idea is flying cats, secondary is aerial fight, critters and real-time physics (even the buildings can be destroyed brick by brick).

Building the cat bodies was quite interesting. At first, Opus 5.5 had lots of issues with generating cats that are not just circles. Each more advanced body (especially cats' faces - those seem to be harder for some reason) ended up looking pretty hellish. Workaround was to generate images, use them with tripo3d to generate bodies and then rig the glbs separately with Opus (it's great for adding motion to elements).

Would love to hear what you think! You can try it here - [**catcopter.com**](https://catcopter.com)
